verdict.rationale: Plausible documents importing historical data from Google Analytics (docs-11, docs-22, docs-31, gh-1, gh-4) and a separate CSV stats import (docs-50), which covers both routes in the story: another analytics tool and a data export. The Events API (docs-1) records live pageviews and events rather than doing bulk backfill. Missing for 10: evidence that imports keep event-level granularity rather than aggregated stats, supported sources beyond Google Analytics, a programmatic or API-driven bulk import path for developers, in-depth documentation of the CSV format and limits, and independent hands-on corroboration.
